purpose: No-retraining diagnostic separating new-association failure from novel-token copying in the E4 delayed-use candidate.
candidate_role: Trained E4 candidate evaluated without any further optimizer step.

interpretation.association_signal: correct-state accuracy above controls with values seen during training
interpretation.copy_signal: held-out novel values from the primary attempt
interpretation.no_training: this run cannot improve capability or publish a candidate

retention: Keep report and raw answers; no checkpoint save, no base copy.
claims: Diagnostic only; no capability, deployment or generalization claim.
